prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign the attached Blue Hermit grapple close-up as a cleaner two-row reference sheet. The input is the current design to simplify. Keep the same warm pale wooden articulated left arm and hand, tobacco leather bracer, and indigo bell sleeve and wraps. Both rows show precisely the SAME palm-facing left forearm at precisely the SAME scale and angle, elbow left, hand right, matched vertically. Plain pale background. Text labels only "EMPTY DOCK" and "STOWED GRAPPLE".
Design goal: the stowed assembly must read as ONE big round brass-and-blue reel and ONE strong broad crescent hook at small gameplay scale. Make the reel noticeably larger than the input: its circular face diameter about 75–85 percent of the bracer height at that point. Simple round outer brass flange with a dark bronze rim, clearly visible thick coiled flat indigo ribbon between the flanges; show a little thickness and a dark outline. Center hub is quiet flat muted blue enamel, no tiny studs, stars or spikes. Set the reel on the elbow half of the bracer, centered exactly over the empty socket in the top row. One short broad strip of indigo ribbon exits the reel and goes through the eye of the hook. Keep it taut and easy to trace.
The hook is one compact aged-bronze twin crescent, two bold rounded crescent prongs, wide negative spaces, short shank with eye facing the reel, tips oriented toward wrist; remove any elongated spear nose. It lies flat on the wrist half of the bracer, with the point within the cuff. One wide dark tobacco leather strap crosses ONLY its shank behind the crescent, with a single simple bronze snap, and does not obscure the outline. It holds the hook in place, not the reel. Keep the crescent and round reel visibly separated by a small gap, not piled or floating. Compact but easy to read, stable spacing, no mess of clasps, thick layered saddles or exposed mount peg on the stowed view.
In top row render the same left bracer EMPTY, with two permanent pieces that match the installed row exactly: a circular brass-rimmed recessed keyed socket centered one third along the bracer from elbow to wrist, and one broad simple leather snap strap centered two thirds along from elbow to wrist. The top socket and bottom reel centers must align horizontally; the top strap and bottom strap positions must also align exactly. Socket unobstructed, no reel or hook above. Both arm drawings in frame, same hand anatomy and same glove outline. Keep fittings clear of elbow and wrist joints. Render as the same handcrafted stylized 3D game concept as the attached sheet, readable shape, restrained material detail. Two panels only. No loose middle parts, costume change, mask, extra assembly, glow, watermark, additional text or arrows.
references: Blue grapple docking study shown in the preceding review
